name: dsh-patchouli
description: Native knowledge context for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-agent-loop build && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-artifact-ingestor build && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-crud-test-plugin build && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-session-indexer build && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-workspace-indexer build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-agent-loop typecheck && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-artifact-ingestor typecheck && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-crud-test-plugin typecheck && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-session-indexer typecheck && pnpm --filter @memorax-agent/dsh-patchouli-workspace-indexer typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && cargo build --locked -p patchouli-server --bin patchouli-db && node --test integration/crud-plugin.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
